tasks.label: Build Addin (Release)
tasks.detail: Builds only RevitMCP.Addin — safe while an AI client/Bridge is running. AppLoader auto-reloads the new DLL in Revit.

tasks.label: Build Full Solution (Release)
tasks.detail: Builds all projects including Bridge. Stop your AI client (Claude/Codex/Antigravity) first — this will kill the Bridge process.
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Name 'RevitMCP.Bridge' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; dotnet build RevitMCP.slnx -c Release
